title: Saving an answer on the waiting page gets a visible reply
why: Your gripe, Oct 26 (waiting page): "would also prefer if there was a way that submitting questions resulted in a reaction"; today you type "submitted" by hand.
note: Measured Oct 26 (c71): a page save wakes no session. To check first: whether the page can also send a comment to Claude through the comments capability, which wakes a session watching the page; then the owning session reacts or replies. Needs no answer from you. Port: yes; every repo's page comes from the skill. Placed ahead of c100, after c71's slot (triage, Oct 27).
